info.name: Visitor Management API
info.description:
Walks the visitor workflow: invitations with validation and duplicate protection, own-only visibility, editing and cancelling, the gate list and pass lookup, check-in only on the day, no check-out before check-in, the daily report and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8104). Repeatable: it registers a fresh employee and uses random visitor phone numbers and names each run.

exec: const digits = (n) => Array.from({ length: n }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 10)).join("");
const day = (offset) => { const d = new Date(Date.now() + offset * 864e5); return d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0"); };
